name: dolly-zoom
title: Dolly Zoom
description: The vertigo shot: a corridor with a red door stretches deeper while the subject in the middle keeps its exact size. A host puts its own subject in by replacing the .dz-subject svg with its own centered content.
useWhen: A realization or a turning point in the story needs one unsettling, cinematic beat.
A logo, product or figure should stay perfectly still while the space around it warps.
avoidWhen: You need to move from one scene to the next, not a held shot: use push-through.
The move should feel calm and simply show depth: use parallax-depth.
author: Remocn
